in_marathi.name: Devanshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devanshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devanshi means 'Goddess of Gods'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deva' which means 'God' and 'Ansh' which means 'Presence'. According to Hindu mythology, Devanshi is the goddess who incarnates as a human to bring peace and prosperity.
